coverage_note: Reviewed the supplied text from all 13 PDF pages, including figure captions and tables. Figure pixels and supplementary materials were unavailable; this finding does not depend on them.

findings.candidate_quote: the pipeline correctly identified expansions in 82% of DM1 subjects
findings.reference_quote:
A total of 28 out of 34 subjects (82%) with DM1 agreed
with SB data.
findings.explanation: The 82% measures agreement with Southern blot classification, not successful expansion detection. The article reports that all DM1 patients were confirmed to have expansions exceeding 50 repeats. Despite the preceding accurate statement about all cases, this sentence incorrectly presents classification agreement as the expansion detection rate.
